decision.question: review size
decision.why: page layout change on every AI page: dashboard head, Tasks tab routing, first tab renamed Home

findings.text: On the Tasks tab the head marks **Home** as the current tab, not Tasks (navigation: the current place is marked) — shots/tasks-1200.png, top band: HOME wears the active underline while the page below is the task filter. The Tasks url forwards to `/framework/ai/?…`, which the Home link's href matches; the reader cannot tell which tab they are on.

About 45 px of empty grey sits between the head and the first dashboard card (spacing) — layout.json: head ends at 58, `ad-dash` starts at 88 at 1200 (97 → 125 at 400), plus the dashboard's own 1em top padding; shots/…/1200.png, band 2.

At 400 the tab strip clips mid-word ("QUEUE" cut at the right edge) with no fade or arrow to say it swipes — shots/…/400.png, top band. That is the swipe the owner asked for, but nothing shows there is more.

answer.reply: fixed (worktree/ai-head-row, second commit): an Inbox filter on the bare url marks the tab it stands for with aria-current (ai/page.js head()), and rail.css un-lights Home beside it; Router.mark_links matches paths only. Shot: shots/tasks-tab-marked-1600.png. The test also found the page is built once per load, as the dashboard or as the rail, so Home, the title, every tab on the dashboard and Tasks are now full loads (target=_self); in-app, Home opened the old Inbox, a dashboard tab dropped the head, and Tasks drew a blank page.

fixed: the page's flow gap (`:where(.flow) > * + *`, 30 px) doubled the dashboard's own padding; `.page.ad-page > .ad-dash { margin-block-start: 0 }`. Head ends at 58, the dashboard starts at 58 with its 1em padding.

declined: the owner had the tab strip's edge fade removed (ext/tabs), so a tab cut mid-word at the edge is the sign that it swipes. Swipe proof added: shots/swipe-390-before.png and -after.png (strip 627 px in a 283 px box, moves 344 px).
